about: The sample space a new account starts with, created and encrypted on the device right after the vault is set up. Shared by the web and mobile apps (keep both copies identical). List entries get fresh ids when created.

space.name: Welcome to ArcheSpace
space.description: A quick tour of spaces, items and your vault. Delete it whenever you like.

content.text:
ArcheSpace keeps everything in spaces. A space works like a folder: it holds items, and each item is one kind of content, such as a note, a checklist, a table or a whiteboard.

Everything you write is encrypted on your device before it is saved. Only your vault PIN opens it, so nobody else can read it, not even the server.

Have a look at the items below, try a few things, then delete this space when you're done.

items.text: Create a space of your own
Tag an item, then filter by that tag
Protect an item so it needs your PIN to open
Keep your recovery code somewhere safe

content.text: Your vault PIN unlocks your data. It never leaves your device, so nobody can reset it for you by email.
The recovery code you saved during setup is the way back in if you forget your PIN. Keep it offline, somewhere safe.
The vault locks itself after a while without use.
Lock it yourself any time from the sidebar.
A protected item asks for your PIN again, even while the vault is open.
If you lose both your PIN and your recovery code, your data can't be recovered. That's the trade-off for nobody else holding a key.

This note is protected. Its title stays visible, but its content opens only with your vault PIN, even while the vault is unlocked.

Protect any item or space from its menu. It suits passwords, ID numbers and anything else you'd rather not show on screen by accident.
